faq.question: Do you follow site safety rules?
faq.answer: Yes. Our teams wear the required protective equipment, attend site inductions and follow the safety plan of the site.

faq.question: Can you work on a large building?
faq.answer: Yes. We size the team to the surface area and deadline, and plan the work floor by floor with the site manager.

faq.question: Do you also clean homes after renovation?
faq.answer: Yes. For private homes, see our post-renovation cleaning service.
